listing.name: NFL Head Coach 09 (NFL Head Coach 09 Static Recomp)
listing.summary: An NFL Head Coach 09 Windows setup route that compiles locally from your own Xbox 360 disc image, title 45410841. HC09Setup.exe extracts the executable and builds the player. Keep the ISO at its configured path for every run: default.xex and image.pe outputs do not replace all disc data. Renderer and progression limits remain. Exact host CPU architecture and accepted region/revision/hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
